classes.name: ObjectMutationLifecycleModule
classes.description: Private Sekai-owned module whose small interface concentrates direct and generation-fenced object create, update, delete, and replay persistence behind one guarded-or-direct seam.

classes.name: SekaiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates callers, enforces tenant, namespace, marking, schema, and object admission, and maps protocol messages and errors around Sekai domain modules.

classes.name: GuardedObjectMutationAdapter
classes.description: Generation-fenced persistence adapter that binds object mutation, lease validation, idempotent replay, and audit in the backend transaction.

classes.name: DirectObjectMutationAdapter
classes.description: Direct persistence adapter that commits an admitted object mutation and its audit without a lease precondition.

relations.name: delegates_object_mutation_to
relations.description: The gRPC transport delegates admitted create, update, and delete persistence through the object mutation lifecycle module instead of maintaining parallel guarded and direct paths.

relations.name: selects_guarded_mutation_adapter
relations.description: The object mutation lifecycle module selects generation-fenced persistence when an admitted request carries a lease precondition.

relations.name: selects_direct_mutation_adapter
relations.description: The object mutation lifecycle module selects direct audited persistence when an admitted request has no lease precondition.
